purpose: Freeze the sole Campaign265 formula, direction, source projection, point-in-time clock, mapping, missingness, aggregation, denominator, capacity, uniqueness and failure semantics before any Tushare response or research value is opened.

official_source_contract.credential_source: repository .env TUSHARE_TOKEN, to be loaded only by a separately frozen confirmed acceptance workflow

cb_daily.request_mode: exactly one request per frozen accepted A-share trade_date, never code-looped or paginated
cb_daily.publication_clock: daily at 17:00 Asia/Shanghai per official documentation

official_source_contract.request_failure_semantics: Any permission, transport, schema, truncation, pagination, identity, date or persistence failure terminates this exact source acceptance. Preserve intent/failure evidence, issue no same-contract retry and do not add fields or substitute endpoints.

identity_and_point_in_time_contract.bond_identity: NFKC-trimmed uppercase ts_code with exact one-row uniqueness in cb_basic
identity_and_point_in_time_contract.equity_identity: NFKC-trimmed uppercase stk_code mapped by the frozen repository A-share symbol canonicalizer
identity_and_point_in_time_contract.mapping_conflict_semantics: A bond mapped to zero or multiple equities is fatal; multiple bonds may map to one equity and are aggregated only by the frozen median rule.
identity_and_point_in_time_contract.active_interval: list_date <= trade_date and (delist_date is null or trade_date <= delist_date)
identity_and_point_in_time_contract.signal_information_clock: A cb_daily row for trade_date t is first usable at the next accepted A-share session open because the provider documents a 17:00 daily update.
identity_and_point_in_time_contract.corporate_action_semantics: Use only the provider's trade-date-specific cb_over_rate. Never use mutable cb_basic conv_price/remain_size, never reconstruct a conversion price, and never forward-fill a missing daily premium.
identity_and_point_in_time_contract.history_correction_semantics: The first immutable accepted full-history snapshot is the sole Campaign265 source. Later provider changes cannot rewrite it or rescue a failure.

single_factor_definition.name: convertible_bond_equity_parity_premium_compression_3s
single_factor_definition.lag_session: the accepted A-share session exactly three calendar entries before t
single_factor_definition.endpoint_eligibility: The same bond must be active and have one exact cb_daily row with finite cb_over_rate and finite strictly positive amount at both t_minus_3 and t.
single_factor_definition.issuer_aggregation: Arithmetic median across all eligible exact-CB per-bond compression values mapped to the same equity on t; even-cardinality median is the average of the two central sorted finite values.
single_factor_definition.no_active_or_no_eligible_bond_semantics: missing, never zero and never carried forward
single_factor_definition.tie_semantics: Exact float64 equality is retained; later cross-sectional ranks use average ties.
forbidden_inputs: rating, redemption, issue or holder fields
equity price, return, volume, amount, valuation or fundamental fields

source_denominator_and_no_return_gates.daily_denominator: Accepted factor-universe equities mapped by frozen cb_basic to at least one exact-CB instrument active on signal session t, regardless of whether cb_daily supplies valid endpoint rows.
source_denominator_and_no_return_gates.eligible_numerator: Daily-denominator equities with one finite issuer aggregate under the single factor definition.

ordered_numeric_uniqueness.statistic: median daily average-tie Spearman rank correlation
ordered_numeric_uniqueness.read_order: exact frozen comparator order after every source and coverage gate passes
ordered_numeric_uniqueness.early_stop: first failing comparator terminalizes the candidate; unread later values remain closed

future_development_contract.open_condition: Only after immutable source acceptance, full snapshot verification, all coverage gates and all 143 ordered uniqueness gates pass.
future_development_contract.folds: the three frozen expanding train/validation folds from the historical walk-forward policy
future_development_contract.costs_survival_and_execution_gates: unchanged from the authoritative historical walk-forward policy
future_development_contract.stress_2024_2025_open_condition: one nonzero 2019-2023 survivor and the complete finite campaign frozen before a once-only quasi-out-of-sample opening

mandatory_next_stage.allowed: Implement a zero-network deterministic adapter and synthetic tests, then separately freeze a one-shot source-acceptance planner bound to this contract, code/test hashes, the exact calendar-date list, projection, request count, atomic paths and fail-closed evidence semantics.
